title: Boltace
extract:
The Boltace are a pair of bladed Tonfas, sharing the same aesthetic style as the  Boltor.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Gemini Cross and  Star Divide (Conclave only) stance.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High block angle (60°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Above average status chance (28.00%)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x))
Slam Attack (wiki attack index 2)
Very high block angle (60°)
Above average follow through (0.6x)
Above average attack range (2.50 m)
Above average disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x))

Comparisons:

 Boltace (Normal Attack), compared to  Telos Boltace (Normal Attack):
Lower base damage (176.00 vs. 210.00)

Higher  Slash damage ( 17.6 vs.  10.5)

Acquisition
The Boltace's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.
